entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Rain easing from the south Thursday afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to affect the road Thursday morning. 1 to 3 cm may accumulate near the summit, with lesser amounts down to 800 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to affect the road Thursday evening and Friday morning. 6 to 12 cm may accumulate about the summit, with lesser amounts down to 600 metres.
